description: This policy setting allows you to determine whether end users have the option to allow snapshots to be saved on their PCs. If disabled, end users will have a choice to save snapshots of their screen on their PC and then use Recall to find things they've seen. If the policy is enabled, end users will not be able to save snapshots on their PC. If the policy is not configured, end users will not be able to save snapshots on their PC.
